info.name: Hermes Agent - SA Master Collection (All APIs & Full Scenarios)
info.description: Postman Collection MASTER paling lengkap untuk EKSAD System Analyst Agent (Port 8643). Menguji seluruh API Gateway yang dimiliki Hermes: Discovery /v1/models, Health Check /health, Stateless /v1/chat/completions, Stateful Session Lifecycle /api/sessions (Create, Chat, Stream SSE, History order=desc, List Filter user_id, Delete), serta 5 Skenario Uji Perancangan Dokumen SA (TSD, Flyway DDL 7 Audit Cols, REST @RolesAllowed, RabbitMQ Event Schemas, & STRIDE Threat Analysis).
